name: Cira
problem_solved: Ecommerce sellers lose revenue to slow support, abandoned carts and poor sales messaging. Cira lets one AI agent sell, support and recover sales so no customer is missed.
ideal_customer: Shopify, WooCommerce and other ecommerce businesses that want AI-driven sales and customer support.
features: AI sales assistant trained on the store's products
objections: AI replies feel fake or generic
